title: Extent Of Participation And Possibility Of Settlement
definition: Refers to the socio-political dynamics of the Civil Disobedience Movement (CDM) (1930-34), analyzing the demographic breadth of mass mobilization and the strategic negotiations between the Indian National Congress (INC) and the British Raj.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the shift from elite-led movements to mass-based nationalism and the tactical evolution of 'Satyagraha' as a bargaining tool for constitutional reform.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Extent Of Participation And Possibility Of Settlement.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
